capabilities: Install and remove community plugins and themes on every synced device from a shared saved list
Create a Plugback Seed loader that installs Plugback on new devices
Repair broken installations by re-downloading missing main.js or theme.css files
Combine saved lists from devices that were set up independently
Report sync conflicts and hold local changes until they can sync
disambiguation: Not a vault sync tool; it relies on your existing vault sync and only manages which plugins and themes are installed.
extras: Requires the user to already have a vault sync mechanism (e.g. Git or Obsidian Sync) and to include specific .obsidian config files in it; network access to raw.githubusercontent.com and github.com is needed to read community directories and download plugins and themes.
problem: Vault sync tools carry note files but not which community plugins and themes are installed, so devices drift apart in their setups.

relations.evidence: To choose which plugins are enabled on desktop or mobile, use Device Extensions Switcher.

summary: Vault-sync companion that installs and removes community plugins and themes across devices based on a shared saved list.
